meta.name: atc-pipeline
meta.description: Firebase CF v2 pipeline: form/zoom -> AI coaching artifacts across 3 Firestore DBs; LLM on on-demand pod via the EXTERNAL vLLM controller (ai-project-4e149); downstream triggers chain checkpoint + rubrics. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — keep current.

databases.DEF: (default): queue generation, queue_token, classify, llmmodels, procedures, queue stage log, live assignment
databases.rule: queueref on an [ATC] doc is a same-DB match key (never .get); read gen doc via adminDefault.doc(queueref.path).get()

status.summary: DEPLOYED to PROD (fir-sample-aae4a), DISABLED. Functions (atcPodLifecycle/podWorkerUpdate/atcJobWatchdog) + drain Job (atc-drain-worker) deployed; run.developer granted; classify/pod_worker staged enabled:false (CONFIG_ID=2KklE4mErHRYmp1b1fYv GPT_OSS_120B_ATC, model gpt-oss-120b). Lifecycle confirmed ticking + no-op at the disabled gate. ONLY remaining action: arm (enabled:true) -> launches a 120B pod to drain the pending backlog (261 at deploy).

controller.auth: Firebase ID token w/ claims approved:true + role poddeployer/admin, minted KEYLESS (no key stored): runtime SA impersonates signer SA pod-token-minter@ai-project-4e149 (needs roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on it) -> createCustomToken({approved,role}) signed via IAM signBlob -> signInWithCustomToken(web api key) -> idToken (cached ~1h). Signer overridable via env POD_CONTROLLER_SIGNER_SA. Mint+claims chain verified live (with the admin key, before switching to keyless).
controller.launchPod: POST {data:{config_id}} -> {result:{pod_id, public_url, gpu_used}}; one-pod-per-config lock (FAILED_PRECONDITION); per-user cooldown (RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED)
controller.infer: POST {public_url}/v1/chat/completions  Authorization: Bearer <pod bearer>  OpenAI body {model,messages} -> {choices:[{message.content, finish_reason}], usage.total_tokens}
controller.podEvents: pod self-reports to the controller via HMAC (ready/terminating/terminate/failed); controller has its OWN idle watchdog that reaps idle pods server-side — a safety net behind our terminate.

nodes.label: Stage 0 processStage
nodes.note: form:[FORM] formsByClient; zoom:[DEF] stage log+live assignment; dedup queueref+profileid+token+stage+sourceref

nodes.label: atcPodLifecycle
nodes.note: IDLE: shouldStartPod gate (minJobs/flushWait) -> launchAndLoad; LOADING: /health poll -> advanceToReady, or load-timeout -> HALTED

nodes.label: launchPod (controller)
nodes.note: launchAndLoad: launchPod(config_id) -> sets classify/pod_worker state=LOADING, podid, apiUrl(public_url); soft errors roll back to IDLE

nodes.label: podWorkerUpdate
nodes.note: X-Api-Key push: ready (=advanceToReady, optional if controller webhook wired) | drained (=terminate) | unhealthy (=HALT+terminate) | info

nodes.label: markReady
nodes.note: no pending->terminate; workerRunning->skip; else->READY+start drain job

nodes.label: triggerWorkerJob
nodes.note: Cloud Run Jobs API {project}/{region}/jobs/{WORKER_JOB_NAME}:run via metadata access token; runtime SA needs run.jobs.run

nodes.label: drain worker (Cloud Run JOB)
nodes.note: runs >1h; loop claim->/v1/chat/completions->write until empty; then POST podWorkerUpdate {event:drained}; env PODWORKER_UPDATE_URL + FUNCTIONS_SHARED_SECRET

nodes.label: claimNextJob/writeJobResult/requeueJob
nodes.note: FIFO txn claim; ownership-guarded write; requeue attempts cap 3 -> error (no infinite loop)

nodes.label: pod /v1/chat/completions (bearer)
nodes.note: callInfer: OpenAI chat completions; parses choices[0].message.content + finish_reason + usage.total_tokens; INFER_TIMEOUT_MS (env, default 20m)

nodes.label: terminatePod (controller)
nodes.note: terminateAndReset: terminatePod(podid) (NOT_FOUND=ok) then clear runtime state to IDLE (drain) or HALTED (failure)

nodes.label: atcJobWatchdog
nodes.note: stuck processing>30m -> requeue (attempts-capped); backlog & pod_worker state not LOADING/READY -> critical

nodes.label: getJobRequest/submitJobResult/run_jobrequest/ensurePod/doTerminatePod/atcPodScheduler
nodes.note: in-pod self-loop + RunPod-direct create/terminate. UN-EXPORTED from index.js (not deployed). Kept in tree for rollback only.

nodes.label: onQueueAtcGenerationUpdate
nodes.note: A: completed&checkpoint&generateatc->Stage2; B: rubrics completed&verdict->extract; C: checkpoint completed->vice-versa

nodes.label: Stage 3 processAtcAlphaDoc
nodes.note: filters; find AI output+checkpoint; classify/rubrics_prompt; dedup queueref+profileid+token+stage+type

edges.label: pod loads 10-20m; /health poll OR controller ready webhook

nodes.role: state machine + atcPodLifecycle + podWorkerUpdate + Cloud Run trigger + controller terminate
external vLLM controller client: minted deployer ID token + launchPod/getPodBearer/terminatePod
Cloud Run JOB drain loop (not a function); /v1/chat/completions + drained signal

entryPoints: worker/drain.js (Cloud Run JOB — separate deploy, not via index.js)

secrets._note: Controller auth is KEYLESS — NO service-account key/secret. See controller.auth + the IAM steps in pending.
secrets.FUNCTIONS_SHARED_SECRET: X-Api-Key for podWorkerUpdate + drain Job 'drained' signal
secrets.RUNPOD_API_KEY: legacy (only used by retired runpod_ai create/terminate)

configDocs.classify/pod_worker: [DEF] SINGLE merged state+config doc. runtime: state/podid/apiUrl/bearerToken/workerRunning/currentJobPath. config: CONFIG_ID (controller pod_config — user-provided, fixed), FIREBASE_COLLECTION_NAME, minJobsToStartPod(20)/flushWaitMinutes(120)/loadTimeoutMinutes(30), WORKER_JOB_NAME/WORKER_REGION/WORKER_PROJECT (Cloud Run Job), model(served_model_name)/maxTokens/maxAttempts, SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL
configDocs.classify/pod_scheduler: [DEF] LEGACY thresholds for retired atcPodScheduler + still read by atcJobWatchdog (stuckProcessingMinutes/flushWaitMinutes/maxAttempts/SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL) — fold remaining keys into pod_worker eventually
